purpose.zh: 俯卧撑加推的入门版，膝盖跪着先把肩胛推地的劲儿找到
purpose.en: The entry version of the push-up plus: on your knees, find how to push the floor with your shoulder blades.

text.zh: 手肘锁死别弯，只让肩胛骨动
text.en: Lock your elbows, only your shoulder blades move

text.zh: 手放在肩膀正下方，膝盖跪稳，从膝盖到头是一条斜线。
text.en: Hands right under your shoulders, knees planted, one straight slope from your knees to your head.

text.zh: 胸口往地上沉，两块肩胛骨靠拢；再用手把地推开，推到后背微微拱起。
text.en: Let your chest drop so your shoulder blades come together, then push the floor away until your upper back rounds slightly.

text.zh: 推到最高停一秒，肩膀离耳朵远一点，屁股别跟着上下晃。
text.en: Wait a second at the top, shoulders away from your ears, and keep your hips from bobbing.

commonErrors.zh: 手肘跟着弯，变成跪姿俯卧撑
commonErrors.en: Bending your elbows and turning it into a kneeling push-up.
Shrugging and pushing your head forward.

commonErrors.zh: 屁股往后坐或者塌腰，靠腰动不是肩胛骨在动
commonErrors.en: Sitting your hips back or sagging your lower back, so your waist moves instead of your shoulder blades.

cautions.zh: 膝盖硌得疼就垫块毛巾
cautions.en: If your knees hurt on the floor, put a towel under them.

training.source: thomas-sup r2 animation tempo (4 s per rep, 1 s at the top; brief: 顶端停 1 秒)

thomasSupplement.thomasAngle: 10 第一侧移重 / 14 第二侧移重（初级）
thomasSupplement.camera: 正侧面＋斜后上方（同动作 1）
thomasSupplement.doseBrief: 同动作 1 的低阶版：3 组 × 10–12 次，休 60 秒；顶端停 1 秒
thomasSupplement.note: defaultDose takes the low end of the brief range; the range is in doseBrief. r2: one rep 4 s (push 1.5 s, top 1 s, sink 1.3 s, 0.2 s at the bottom), same as t-pushup-plus.
